pattern: ^SELECT .+ MIN\(COUNT\(\*\)\).+FROM .+ group\ by\ transcript\_id  ORDER BY .+ min\_count  ASC LIMIT 1
correction: Join the Transcripts table, group by both tables' transcript_id, order by count(*) and limit the result to the top 1 record with the highest count.

metadata.description: This rule identifies queries that incorrectly use MIN(COUNT(*)) instead of counting occurrences, and suggests a correction to fix the error.
